 -versus-

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Parties
 Mr. K.K. Das, Additional Standing Counsel
 Coram:
 Shri Justice B. P. Routray
 Order
18.10.2023 Order No.
04. 1.
The matter is taken up through hybrid mode.
2. Heard Mr. A.K. Parida, learned counsel for the Appellant and Mr. K.K. Das, learned ASC.
3. Perused the report of learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum- Special Judge, Keonjhar dated 13th October, 2023.

The learned Additional Sessions Judge has stated in her report that 13 witnesses including the victim have already been examined and the trial is awaiting evidence of the investigating officer and the medical officer.
The learned trial judge has further stated that the trial may be completed within two months expectedly.
4. The offences alleged are under Section 376-D/506 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 3(2)(v) of the SC and ST (PoA) Act.
5. Upon hearing both parties and considering the statements of the witnesses including victim (P.W.1), I am not inclined to release the Appellant on bail.
Accordingly the prayer for bail is rejected.

6. However, learned trial court is directed to take all appropriate steps to procure attendance of witnesses for early completion of trial.
7.
The CRLA is accordingly disposed of.
8. A copy of this order shall be communicated to the learned trial court without delay.

( B.P. Routray) Judge M.K.Panda Lala @ Laljit Sahu vs State Of Odisha And Another .... ... on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/177289202/
